help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Gives most of the Stalker's damaging attacks a 4% chance to recharge Build Up and reduces recharge time by {Boost.Attrib.Recharge.Scale}%.  This enhancement can only be slotted by Stalkers and can be slotted into nearly all Stalker damage powers.
power_display_names: (Stalker) Assassin's Mark: Recharge/Chance to Recharge Build Up
power_short_helps: Increases Attack Rate and Chance to Recharge Build Up
